nodes.description: Counters.Counter tracking the next ERC721 token id to be minted in CollectorX.
Global sale state flag; must equal 1 for Buy() to succeed.
Base mint price in wei, owner-configurable, default 0.1 ether.
Base URI prefix used to build token metadata URIs.
Mapping tokenId => rarity tier (1..4) assigned from the pseudo-random generator.
Ownable private owner address controlling onlyOwner functions and receiving Win payouts.
Owner-only setter for the sale state flag.
Owner-only setter for the mint price.
Owner-only setter for the metadata base URI.
ERC721 override returning the stored base URI.
Owner-only batch mint that increments the counter, safe-mints to the owner and assigns rarity via random().
Read-only search returning the first token id with a given rarity tier.
Weak pseudo-random generator built from block.timestamp, block.difficulty and the token counter.
Burns four tokens owned by the caller if they cover all rarity tiers and pays out two thirds of the contract balance.
Payable mint entry point; validates state and price, pays a referrer bonus, safe-mints and assigns rarity.
Returns the current counter value as total minted supply.
Computes the dynamic price as base price plus a supply-based increment.
Owner-only function forwarding the whole contract balance with a low-level call.
Internal setter writing the rarity of an existing token.
Public view returning the rarity tier of an existing token.
Builds the metadata URI by concatenating base URI, rarity and token id.
CollectorX constructor initialising ERC721 name/symbol and Ownable owner.
Caller-controlled address used for minting, ownership checks, referrer lookups and payouts.
Miner-influenceable timestamp used as randomness entropy in random().
Transaction origin; declared for completeness though not directly referenced in CollectorX.
payable(referer).transfer(msg.value * rate / 10) sends ETH to a caller-supplied address inside Buy().
_safeMint triggers IERC721Receiver.onERC721Received on the recipient contract, an external callback into user code.
payable(msg.sender).transfer(pay) sends ETH to the caller inside Win().
payable(owner()).transfer(pay) sends ETH to the owner inside Win().
payable(owner()).call{value: address(this).balance}("") low-level ETH transfer inside withdraw().
Randomness derived from block.timestamp and block.difficulty, predictable and miner-influenceable.
msg.value * rate / 10 reward computation with truncation/precision risk on user-supplied value.
uint256 state argument of setState.
uint256 newprice argument of setPrice.
string newURI argument of setBaseURI.
uint256 quantity argument of OwnerMint controlling loop iterations.
uint raralevel argument of getRaraToken.
uint[4] tokens argument of Win holding the four token ids to redeem.
address referer argument of Buy receiving the referral bonus.
uint256 tokenId argument of _setTokenRara/getTokenRara/tokenURI.
uint rarity argument written by _setTokenRara.
Local tokenId read from the counter before minting in OwnerMint and Buy.
Local rarity value returned by random() and passed to _setTokenRara.
Local payout amount address(this).balance / 3 in Win.
Local referral rate derived from referer balance, capped at 5.
Loop index used in OwnerMint, Win and tokenURI.
Local minimum of a,b,c used to select the rarity bracket in random().
Locals a, b, c holding the timestamp/difficulty-derived hash values in random().

edges.reason: msg.sender is passed as the recipient of _safeMint in OwnerMint.
Win authorises the payout using ownerOf(tokens[i]) == msg.sender.
Buy mints the new token to msg.sender.
_msgSender() is forwarded into the untrusted onERC721Received callback.
setState is gated by onlyOwner comparing owner() to _msgSender().
setPrice is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
setBaseURI is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
withdraw is gated by onlyOwner and pays the owner.
block.timestamp feeds the hash entropy inside random().
Timestamp dependency creates the weak randomness used for rarity.
random() produces the predictable rarity value.
setState writes the _state variable.
setPrice writes the _price variable.
setBaseURI writes the _BaseURI variable.
_baseURI reads the _BaseURI state variable.
OwnerMint reads and increments _tokenIdCounter.
OwnerMint calls random() to derive rarity.
OwnerMint calls _setTokenRara with the generated rarity.
getRaraToken iterates up to _tokenIdCounter.current().
getRaraToken reads the _tokenRarity mapping.
random() mixes _tokenIdCounter.current() into its hashes.
Win calls getTokenRara for each of the four token ids.
Win performs an ETH transfer to msg.sender after burning tokens.
Win performs an ETH transfer to owner() after burning tokens.
Buy requires _state == 1 before minting.
Buy validates msg.value against current_price().
Buy transfers ETH to the referer before minting the new token.
Buy invokes _safeMint which calls back into the recipient contract.
Buy reads and increments the _tokenIdCounter.
Buy calls random() to compute the minted token rarity.
Buy stores the rarity through _setTokenRara.
Buy computes the referral amount as msg.value * rate / 10.
totalSupply returns _tokenIdCounter.current().
current_price reads the _price state variable.
current_price calls totalSupply() when computing the increment.
withdraw forwards the entire balance with a low-level call.
_setTokenRara writes into the _tokenRarity mapping.
getTokenRara reads from the _tokenRarity mapping.
tokenURI uses _BaseURI as the metadata prefix.
tokenURI reads _tokenRarity[tokenId] to build the URI path.
The constructor sets the Ownable _owner to the deployer.
withdraw directs the balance to the stored _owner address.
A malicious receiver can re-enter Buy from onERC721Received during _safeMint.
A malicious receiver can re-enter OwnerMint from onERC721Received during _safeMint.
The state parameter is assigned into the _state variable.
The newprice parameter is assigned into _price.
The newURI parameter is assigned into _BaseURI.
quantity bounds the OwnerMint minting loop.
raralevel is compared against _tokenRarity entries inside getRaraToken.
The tokens array drives the ownership checks and burns inside Win.
referer is checked against address(0) inside Buy.
referer is the destination of the referral ETH transfer.
tokenId selects the mapping slot written by _setTokenRara.
rarity is the value stored by _setTokenRara.
The counter-derived local tokenId is passed to _setTokenRara.
The random() result r is passed to _setTokenRara.
Local pay is the amount transferred to msg.sender in Win.
Local pay is the amount transferred to owner() in Win.
rate multiplies msg.value in the referral payout computation.
Loop index i controls the OwnerMint minting loop.
Loop index i controls the Win rarity and burn loops.
m selects the rarity bracket inside random().
a, b and c hold the block.timestamp/block.difficulty hash values in random().

normalization_plan.reason: setState parameter whose only role is writing the _state core variable.
setPrice parameter directly assigned to the _price state variable.
setBaseURI parameter directly assigned to the _BaseURI state variable.
Loop bound argument of OwnerMint with no independent semantics.
Query argument only used to compare against _tokenRarity inside getRaraToken.
Input array consumed entirely by the Win redemption logic.
Buy argument controlling the referral payout branch.
Token id argument identifying the _tokenRarity mapping slot.
Payout amount used only in the Win ETH transfers.
Referrer multiplier consumed by the referral transfer arithmetic.
Loop counter scoped to minting and burn loops.
Intermediate bracket selector confined to random().
Hash intermediates that exist only inside random().
